summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state initialised in __init__ and set/cleared in run()'s run_app coroutine (try/finally around run_async). Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 9 tests covering not-running (before start and after run), same-thread error, widget write, awaitable result, timeout exception re-raise, variadic positional and keyword forwarding, and exit value from run. All 9 pass when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at the repo's src, because the venv's editable textual install points at base/src. Other async test modules in the venv fail with "async def functions are not natively supported" (pytest-asyncio missing), which is unrelated to this change. Nothing committed.
